risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/untested (worst case: may need service).

risks.proof: Video showing the pedal controlling speed while stitching.
risks.if_unproven: Price as pedal/power not guaranteed (worst case: may require replacement).

Send clear close-up photos of the brand/model plate and any label on the machine body.
Send photos of included accessories (bobbin(s), bobbin case, needles, presser feet, power cord, foot pedal).
Send a photo of the bobbin compartment and tension area.
